The level is solved: after 86 moves both heroes stand on doors, and the checker reports WON.

The idea was to get the dragon's breath out of the way without losing the goblin that holds the plate that keeps the lower gate open:

1. The warrior pushed the dragon east to (6,2), so it faces down column 6. Breath is blocked by the crystal placed at (6,4), so the goblin at (6,11) survives.
2. The thief pulled the crystal off (6,4) so the breath killed the goblin at (6,9). The warrior pushed the crystal back into (6,4) on the next move, before the breath could reach the goblin at (6,11).
3. The thief pulled the dragon back to (5,2), where the wall at (5,3) blocks its breath. Column 6 is now safe.
4. The crystal was walked along to (2,6), holding the upper gate open. The goblin at (6,11) keeps the lower gate open.
5. The warrior went to (2,11) first, then the thief to (2,10).
